title: feat(2d): import SVG drawings as 2D sketch profiles
body:
## What changed

The SVG reader, `camcraft_geometry::svg`, reads drawings into the DXF `Document` type. It shares sketch chaining, nesting, `SketchData`, sketch entities, and project storage with DXF import.

- Read paths, lines, polylines, polygons, rectangles, circles, and ellipses.
- Apply group transforms and references to elements in the same file.
- Keep circular arcs analytic. Flatten Beziers and other ellipses within 0.005 mm.
- Read mm, cm, in, pt, pc, and px sizes, `viewBox`, and `preserveAspectRatio`.
- Reflect Y about the page height. Use top-level group labels or IDs as layers.
- Count unsupported content, hidden content, markers and paint-only stylesheets as skipped. This includes stylesheets inside `<defs>`.
- Add the undoable `ImportSvg` command, the `import_svg` MCP tool, and the `cam.importSvg` script verb.
- Update the user guide and MCP reference. Record decisions in `docs/decisions/1880-svg-import.md`.

## Refusals

The reader names malformed input, unsupported units, invalid sizes, singular transforms, and exceeded import limits. A file without physical units needs the caller's unit. A sized file refuses a caller unit.

The reader also refuses root `<svg>` transform attributes, and `transform-origin` and `transform-box` presentation attributes.

The reader finds a duplicate attribute name with a map. The scan that it replaces was quadratic in the attribute count of one tag.

The reader reads an inline `style` against an allow-list of the properties that cannot change geometry (`SAFE_PROPERTIES` in `svg/facts.rs`). The reader refuses each other property by name. The reader reads the style and the transform of an element one time, finds a `use` target in a map of the ids, and charges the shape data of each visit against a work budget.

These rules close the class "an input changes or hides a shape, and the import ignores it":

- A `<style>` sheet is checked with the same allow-list, with no selector matching (`svg/sheet.rs`). The reader refuses `display`, `visibility` and each property that is not on the list. A paint-only sheet imports.
- The reader refuses an `<?xml-stylesheet?>` instruction and a `<link rel="stylesheet">` by name.
- The reader refuses `animate`, `set`, `animateTransform`, `animateMotion`, `animateColor` and `discard` at each place in the tree.
- A child of a shape or of a `use` that is not `title`, `desc`, `metadata` or `style` is counted as `<child> in <parent>`.
- The reader refuses a `preserveAspectRatio` value that is not in the SVG grammar.
- A marker property that draws a marker is counted as `marker`.
- The user guide says that a shape with a stroke imports as its centre line.

## The fix round for the review on `f96ea8fa0`

1. **One CSS scanner for the inline style and the sheet (`svg/css.rs`, new).** `sheet.rs` and `style.rs` take their pieces from it, so the two cannot split a style at different places.
   - An unquoted `url(` token ends at the first `)` that is not escaped, as in CSS Syntax 3 (4.3.6). In it, a quote starts no string, a `(` adds no level, and a `;`, a brace or a `/*` starts nothing.
   - `url` is found in any case and through escapes (`\75rl(`). `url(` before a quote is a function with a string, and the usual rules apply.
   - A bad url token (a quote, a `(` or a gap in the address) is refused by name: in a sheet at each place (a rule, an `@font-face` block, a prelude), and in the inline style of an imported element.
   - If the same inline style has `display:none`, the shape is hidden as in a browser. Nothing of it is imported, and it is counted as `hidden`.
2. **One function for references (`svg/reference.rs`, new).** After an `&`, the run goes to the first `;`, white space, `&`, `<` or quote. A run that ends at a `;` is a reference.
   - A reference is decoded only if it is one of the five predefined entities, or a character reference to a character that XML permits. The count of leading zeros has no limit.
   - Each other reference is refused by name: an entity name with a character outside ASCII, a run that is not an XML name (`&a=b;`, `A`), a code point that is not a character (`�`, `�`).
   - The namespace exception stays: the value of `xmlns` and `xmlns:*` is not read. A CDATA section has no references.
   - The scan is linear: the next search starts after the run.
3. **Directory suites.** This PR adds no new top-level test binary to a crate that has a directory suite for it.
   - `crates/app/tests/mcp_svg.rs` is now `crates/app/tests/mcp/svg.rs`, a module of the existing `mcp` suite. Its 2 tests are the same.
   - The four files `svg_refusals.rs`, `svg_style_safety.rs`, `svg_tree_rules.rs` and `svg_visibility.rs` are now modules in `crates/geometry/tests/svg/`. The two new pin files are there too.
   - New top-level test file: `crates/geometry/tests/svg.rs`. Reason: `crates/geometry/tests/` had no directory suite for the SVG reader, and this file is the root of the new one (one binary in place of five).
   - `#[test]` count of the SVG suite: 61 before (16 + 19 + 6 + 9 + 11), 74 now. The 13 more are the new pins.

One existing pin changed its expected text. `.a{fill:url(a}b);transform:scale(2)}` was refused as "style sheet has a ';' outside a rule". The scanner now reads the `}` as a part of the address, and the reader refuses the file as "style sheet transform".

## Validation on the final head

Head: `ccb0ed35486a1689323753d5efc0b757b959fa39`. It has one commit after `245e84fa1`: a merge of `upstream/main` `074c23ba6`. The head `245e84fa1` had no review, thus this push has no review finding.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 1,190 steps, 1 failed, 0 stalled, 20.5 minutes. The red step is `app suites: rotary_verify`; see below |
| `clippy -D warnings` | PASS: a step of the quick gate |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | PASS: 98 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 17.8 minutes |
| `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | PASS in the quick gate |
| `app suites: mcp` (has `mcp/svg.rs`), `mcp_doc_drift` | PASS in the quick gate |
| `geometry suites: svg` | PASS in the quick gate |

**The red step is the red step of main.** `rotary_verify::a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius` fails (2110 moves, expected 2064). Issue #3774 records the same failure of the post-merge gate on main `074c23ba6`. This PR changes no rotary, motion or sim file. This PR does not correct it.

**Merge of main.** The merge `ccb0ed354` had one conflict.

- `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` (a generated file). I wrote it again with `cargo run -p camcraft-app --bin camcraft-cli -- mcp reference`. It has 124 tools: the 123 tools of main and `import_svg`.
- The merge has no other hand edit. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is the file of main.

Main moved to `f6716cdcd` during the gates. `git merge-tree` of this head with that main is clean. The gates did not run against that main.

The gate light did not run again in this round. The earlier merge `3178256d7` (main `6167d30af`) and its gates are in the PR comments.

**Pin proof.** (From the round on `245e84fa1`; the merge changes no code of this PR, and I did not run the mutations again.) For each row, I made the mutation, ran `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test svg`, and restored the code. With the code restored, all 74 tests pass.

| Mutation | Red pins |
|---|---|
| The scanner does not read `url(` tokens (`css.rs`: the `url(` arm is off). This is the behaviour before the fix. | `url_tokens::svg_style_sheet_bad_url_tokens_are_refused_by_name`, `url_tokens::svg_font_face_block_with_a_bad_url_token_is_refused_by_name`, `url_tokens::svg_inline_bad_url_tokens_are_refused_by_name_on_a_shape_a_group_and_the_root`, `url_tokens::svg_inline_display_none_after_a_bad_url_token_hides_the_shape`, `url_tokens::svg_a_comment_start_in_a_url_token_hides_no_declaration`, `url_tokens::svg_good_url_tokens_import_at_the_attribute_size`, `tree_rules::svg_style_sheet_rules_that_hide_or_resize_a_shape_are_refused_by_name` |
| A reference that is not a character stays as text, and a character reference with more than 9 digits is not decoded (`reference.rs`). This is the behaviour before the fix. | `references::svg_entity_names_outside_ascii_are_refused_at_each_place`, `references::svg_a_run_that_is_not_an_xml_name_is_refused_when_it_ends_at_a_semicolon`, `references::svg_character_references_with_leading_zeros_are_decoded_in_an_attribute`, `references::svg_character_references_with_leading_zeros_are_decoded_in_a_style_sheet`, `references::svg_character_references_that_are_not_a_character_are_refused_by_name`, `tree_rules::svg_doctype_entity_references_are_refused_by_name` |

These pins stay green in the two mutations, because they pin what must still import: `references::svg_predefined_and_plain_references_read_as_before`, `references::svg_many_reference_starts_read_in_linear_time`, and the usual `url(data:font/woff2;base64,AAAA)` rule in `tree_rules::svg_paint_only_style_sheets_import_at_the_attribute_size`.

The pins of the earlier rounds are in `tests/svg/tree_rules.rs`, `style_safety.rs`, `refusals.rs` and `visibility.rs`. Their mutation table is in the review record of `671426992`. I did not run those mutations again in this round.

## Goldens moved

None. The catalog suites ran and passed on the final head. The diff against `upstream/main` changes no recorded program, golden or snapshot PNG.

## Not exercised

- I did not check the url and reference cases in a browser. The expected results are from CSS Syntax 3 and XML 1.0.
- The three follow-ups of the review on `f96ea8fa0` are not in this round: `<!ATTLIST` defaults of the DOCTYPE (`P3`), `systemLanguage` and `requiredExtensions` (`P3`), and a count of `<script>` and event attributes (`P7`). The review says to file them after the merge.
- A sheet scan does not follow `(` and `[` levels across a `}`. I examined this, and each case that I found is refused, not imported. It has no pin of its own.
- A posted G-code golden for an SVG profile remains in follow-up #3042.
- The `import_svg` row in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` remains outside this PR.
- Nested SVG viewports, selector matching of a style sheet, text to outlines, and embedded images remain outside this reader's scope.
- The merge with main `f6716cdcd` is not built and not gated. The merged main is `074c23ba6`.
- The description of the `import_svg` MCP tool is not changed.
- The four follow-ups of the first review on `eaafd2e72` (Inkscape long style, `vector-effect` attribute, the 5 s time limits, the skill row) are not changed.

No UI source changed. Before/after screenshots do not apply.

Changelog: Import SVG drawings (paths, shapes, group transforms, mm/cm/in/pt/pc/px sizes) as 2D profiles on the stock, with the `import_svg` MCP tool and `cam.importSvg`; an SVG with no physical size is refused until you state its unit.

Effort: high

Fixes #1880
